score: 163/270 simplified with every protected table proved, 0 wrong; 39% of the reference reduction
metric: Pipelines of 3 to 20 tables with protected tables that must keep their names and exact output: KumoSQL's Refactor search returns its simplest pipeline, scored by sqlfluff complexity plus one per table (kumosql.formatting.pipeline_complexity). Quality is (original - output) / (original - reference), averaged.
correctness: 0 wrong: every output's protected tables agree with the original on 100 random and targeted DuckDB databases (optimizer off) plus every trap witness, and 269/270 are proved by prove_models (1 agrees but is not re-proved by the harness). Negative control: the first trap of 24 dev cases is fed to the checker and each is counted wrong; the cases hold 711 traps, each with a stored witness.
held_out: 64 cases (59 generated, 5 hand-written), run once: 22/64 simplified and proved, 23 improved, 0 wrong, quality 0.24
caveats: Cases written for this eval with Claude (241 generated from templates, 29 hand-written dev cases), each reference verified on 300 DuckDB databases; KumoSQL proves 170 of the 334 references in full. References are targets, not optima: the search beats 5 of them. Inlining into readers counts as more complex, so the search rarely removes pass-through chains (quality 0.14 on that family).
usefulness: 164/270 dev cases improved (60.7%); total complexity 4,831.5 -> 3,848.5 against 2,682.5 for the references; by family: dead tables 94/94, duplicated logic 77/78, unused columns and joins 59/80, mergeable tables 66/104, redundant filters 44/70, CTE repeats 36/80, pass-through chains 40/93
performance: Search: median 3.5 s per case, max 67 s, 1,530 s in total on the dev split (4 workers; search limit 60 s per case). Checking: 831 s.
